final class AuthControllerTest extends HttpTestCase

    #[Test]
    public function get_login_mostra_formulario_quando_nao_autenticado(): void
    {
        $r = $this->get('/auth/login');
        $this->assertStatus(200, $r);
        $this->assertBodyContains('Entrar', $r);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function post_login_com_password_correta_redireciona_painel(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeUser(['password' => 'secret123']);

        $r = $this->post('/auth/login', [
            'email'    => $user['email'],
            'password' => 'secret123',
            'next'     => '/painel',
        ]);

        $this->assertStatus(302, $r);
        $this->assertNotNull($r['location'], 'Esperado Location header');
        $this->assertSame('/painel', $r['location']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($this->cookies, 'Esperado Set-Cookie com sessao');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function post_login_com_password_errada_redireciona_com_erro(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeUser(['password' => 'certa']);

        $r = $this->post('/auth/login', [
            'email'    => $user['email'],
            'password' => 'errada',
            'next'     => '/painel',
        ]);

        $this->assertStatus(302, $r);
        $this->assertRedirectContains('/auth/login?', $r);
        $this->assertRedirectContains('erro=', $r);
    }
